question: What identity is attributed to the kāma-seed as the lord of the moon?
premises: The kāma-seed is identified as the lord of the moon.
It is described as alone or absolute.
It bears the form of desire.
inference: The kāma-seed is the absolute lord of the moon bearing the form of desire.
plain_english: The kāma-seed is the lord of the moon, alone and bearing the form of desire.
